allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Intimation Of Lapse & Forfeiture Of Convertible Warrants Issued Under SEBI (Issue Of Capital And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018

allot.subject: Press Release
allot.text: T T Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 01, 2025, titled "Rights Issue of 3,33,30,444 Fully Paid-Up Equity Shares aggregating to Rs.40 Crores  announcing that the issue has been oversubscribed by 1.13 times.".

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: T T Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates Submission of Advertisement Regarding Closure of Rights Issue   Regulation 84(3) of SEBI (ICDR) Regulations, 2018

allot.subject: Record Date
allot.text: T T Limited has informed the Exchange that Record date for the purpose of  Intimation Of Record Date For Rights Issue  is 04-Jul-2025.

allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: T T Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on Jun 18, 2025, has decided to issue equity shares on rights basis in the ratio of 4 : 27, i.e 4 Equity Shares for every 27 Equity Shares held. Issue Price is 12 per share.
